title: Where the Light Goes
objective: Show, in under a minute, how sunlight fades with depth in the ocean, how pressure builds, and that the dark deep sea is not dark of light.

message.core_message: Sunlight is gone below about a thousand metres, but most of the animals that live there make their own light.
key_points: Red light is filtered out first; blue goes deepest
Rarely any significant light below 200 m; twilight zone to 1,000 m
Pressure rises about 1 atmosphere per 10 m (roughly 1,100 atm at the Challenger Deep)
76% of observed individuals in 17 years of video off California were bioluminescent

constraints: The 76% figure is scoped to the study: 17 years of ROV video off California, surface to 3,900 m
Procedural imagery is stylised, not photographic, and is not presented as footage

references.description: Reference-derived profile for dark layered reels and the cinematic-documentary registry profile

audio.notes: Layered sound design by depth zone; silence is a tool.

research.reason: Scientific figures: depths, pressure, bioluminescence share.

creative_directions.name: Cinematic descent
creative_directions.concept: One continuous descent. The camera sinks through four water-column zones, each with its own colour, light and sound. Small labels name only what the viewer needs. The numbers become pictures: spectrum bands that vanish in order, lines that compress with pressure, a hundred dots of which seventy-six light up.

visual_identity.palette: deep teal to black, bioluminescent cyan and green, one warm amber for the surface
visual_identity.typography: Oswald uppercase wide tracking, small; Inter text

motion_language.transitions: vertical push, slow dissolve, iris like a porthole

composition.approach: subject off-centre, deep space, one small label

creative_directions.pacing: slow, 4-9 s per beat, motion always alive
creative_directions.why_it_fits: The subject is a journey through depth; the camera can narrate it.

creative_directions.name: Scientific visualisation
creative_directions.concept: A flat labelled depth diagram with isometric zones.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Accurate, but the descent is felt less.

success_criteria: Each zone has a distinct colour and sound bed
